position: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS): Medicare Regulatory Reforms
proposal: The Mandate recommends that CMS eliminate the Medicare inpatient-only list, expand the ambulatory surgical center covered procedures list, and extend site-neutral payment so that Medicare pays the same for a service whether delivered in a physician office, clinic or hospital outpatient department.
remaining: Finish the three-year phase-out of the inpatient-only list
Extend site-neutral payment to additional settings beyond drug administration and selected imaging

flags: judgment call: implemented (65) is also defensible; set to in_progress because the list elimination is one third through a scheduled phase-out and site-neutral payment covers only drug administration so far.

source_checks.note: 285 IPO removals, 3-year phase-out, 276 plus 271 ASC additions, PFS-equivalent drug administration, effective 2026-01-01.
637 proposed IPO removals, 618 ASC codes, imaging without contrast site-neutral proposal, comments to 2026-08-31.

significance.rationale: End Medicare inpatient-only list, expand ASC procedures, and extend site-neutral payment across settings.

status_summary: The CY 2026 outpatient payment final rule, published 2025-11-25 and effective 2026-01-01, starts a three-year phase-out of the inpatient-only list by removing 285 services, adds 276 procedures to the ASC covered procedures list plus 271 codes leaving the inpatient-only list, and pays the physician fee schedule equivalent rate for drug administration at excepted off-campus hospital departments, exempting rural sole community hospitals. The CY 2027 proposed rule of 2026-07-07 would remove 637 more services from the list, add 618 ASC codes, and apply the equivalent rate to imaging without contrast at those departments.

timeline.event: CY 2026 OPPS/ASC final rule published: inpatient-only list phase-out begins with 285 removals, ASC list additions, and a physician fee schedule equivalent rate for drug administration at excepted off-campus departments.
CY 2027 OPPS/ASC proposed rule published: would remove 637 services from the inpatient-only list, add 618 ASC codes, and apply the equivalent rate to certain imaging codes; comments due 2026-08-31.

title: Phase out the Medicare inpatient-only list and expand ASC and site-neutral payment
uncertainties: Only about the first 100,000 characters of each long rule were read. The inpatient-only list still exists until the phase-out ends, so elimination is underway rather than complete. Whether the CY 2027 proposals were finalized in the November 2026 cycle is not yet known.
